mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_CODE, CATEGORY_NAME FROM FAQ_CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NO

SELECT F.FAQ_NO, F.QUESTION, F.ANSWER, F.VIEW_COUNT, F.DISPLAY_ORDER, F.CATEGORY_NO, F.STATUS, TO_CHAR(F.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT, C.CATEGORY_NAME, C.CATEGORY_CODE FROM FAQ F JOIN FAQ_CATEGORY C ON F.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO WHERE F.STATUS = 'A'
AND C.CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode}
AND (F.QUESTION LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR F.ANSWER LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
ORDER BY F.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, F.FAQ_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAQ F WHERE 1=1
AND (F.QUESTION LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR F.ANSWER LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FAQ (FAQ_NO, QUESTION, ANSWER, CATEGORY_NO, DISPLAY_ORDER) VALUES (SEQ_FAQ_NO.NEXTVAL, #{question}, #{answer}, #{categoryNo}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE FAQ SET QUESTION = #{question}, ANSWER = #{answer}, CATEGORY_NO = #{categoryNo}, DISPLAY_ORDER = #{displayOrder}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE FAQ_NO = #{faqNo} AND STATUS = 'A'
